from compile_sized_corpus import Producer
from compact_sized_graph import artifact,remap
from test_hierarchical_qft import port
from test_sized_corpus import circuit_action,difference

g=json.load(open('/private/tmp/qleisli-capacity-graph.json')); c=Producer();root=c.import_artifact(g); assert root==200
# Diagnostic construction only: selected actual original H atoms, with exact
# boundary permutation inferred from the original trace. Not an algorithm API.
h=[17,21,25,29]
def tensor_all(nodes):return nodes[0] if len(nodes)==1 else c.tensor(nodes[0],tensor_all(nodes[1:]))
def pack(ps,owner):
 if len(ps)==1:
  end=port(owner,ps[0]['axes']);b=dict(tag='structural',operation=dict(tag='bit_to_bits'))
  return c.add(ps,[end],b,b,'structural')
 tail=pack(ps[1:],owner+1);after=c.ends(tail)[1]
 layer=c.tensor(c.identity(ps[:1]),tail)
 result=port(owner,sum((p['axes'] for p in ps),[]))
 join=c.structural(ps[:1]+after,[result],'put_bit',len(ps),0)
 return c.sequence([layer,join])
# Keep H0 separate for the first controlled operation; pack H1,H2,H3 afterwards.
tail_h=tensor_all(h[1:]);tail=c.sequence([tail_h,pack(c.ends(tail_h)[1],105)])
layer=c.tensor(h[0],tail)
new_header=c.ends(172)[1][:-1]
layer=c.sequence([layer,c.rewire(c.ends(layer)[1],new_header)])
layer=c.tensor(layer,46)
before=c.ends(200)[0];enter=c.rewire(before,c.ends(layer)[0],[4,3,2,1,0],[5,4,3,2,0,1])
root=c.sequence([enter,layer]+c.definitions[200]['body']['children'][4:])
# Reachable rebuild only. No optimizer changes and no atom body rewriting.
live=set();todo=[root]
while todo:
 i=todo.pop()
 if i not in live:live.add(i);todo+=c.proofs[i]['premises']
r=Producer();indices={}
for i in sorted(live):
 d=c.definitions[i];p=c.proofs[i];before,after=c.ends(i)
 indices[i]=r.add(before,after,remap(d['body'],indices),remap(c.meanings[i]['body'],indices),p['rule']['tag'],[indices[j] for j in p['premises']])
result=artifact(r,indices[root]);assert c.ends(root)==(g['definitions'][200]['interface']['inputs']['quantum'],g['definitions'][200]['interface']['outputs']['quantum'])
one,_=circuit_action(g);two,_=circuit_action(result)
columns=[{i:1} for i in range(64)]+[{i:complex(i%3-1,(i+1)%4-2)/math.sqrt(640) for i in range(64)}]
err=max(difference(one(x),two(x)) for x in columns);assert err<1e-12,err
Path('/private/tmp/qleisli-capacity-candidate.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
print('nodes',len(result['definitions']),'column_error',err,'atoms', {i:indices[i] for i in h})
